none: PAS CAM-F4C1F4: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy radiate of Carausius, AD 286-293
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate of Carausius, AD 286-293 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows an unclear figure, (possibly Victory) advancing left. Obverse legend reads IMP C CARAVSIVS AVG. Obverse shows a radiate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 3.75g, diameter is 21.9mm, thickness is 1.9mm. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus…
